stories.title: US Open 2026 — Two Days Out, Full Preview (Tier 1)

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
**Post 1A** — 8:00 AM ET
Two days. One question: who takes the US Open title?

Zverev enters as No. 1 after Sinner's withdrawal. Alcaraz returns cold from a 4-month wrist injury. Sabalenka eyes a three-peat. Djokovic chases a record 25th major.

Sunday can't come fast enough. 🎾

**Post 1B** — 12:30 PM ET
The US Open draw is loaded. Fils vs. Tsitsipas in Round 1. Alcaraz and Djokovic on the same side. Rybakina racing to be healthy.

History could be made on hard court Sunday. Full preview: [URL]

stories.title: Rybakina's US Open Participation Still in Doubt (Tier 1)

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
**Post 2A** — 9:00 AM ET
Elena Rybakina still hasn't practiced. Still won't confirm she's playing.

The US Open's No. 2 seed injured her left ankle in Cincinnati last week and is racing to be ready for Sunday's first round. Every day matters now.

**Post 2B** — 6:00 PM ET
Rybakina update: no full confirmation on US Open participation as of today.

She retired from Cincinnati's QF with a left ankle injury and has stayed off the court. The No. 2 seed's status is officially day-to-day heading into Sunday.

article.headline: Rybakina's US Open Status in Doubt: No. 2 Seed Has Not Practiced After Cincinnati Ankle Injury

Winston-Salem semifinals are ON today — the last ATP hard-court action before the US Open begins Sunday.

Duckworth vs. Fery. Buse vs. Bonzi. Final is Saturday at 4 p.m. One player gets a title heading into Flushing Meadows.

In Winston-Salem, today's SF winners meet Saturday in the final. The champion earns a trophy — and a boost of confidence — right before New York. 🎾

Arthur Fils won Cincinnati last week. Now his reward at the US Open: a Round 1 match against Stefanos Tsitsipas.

The No. 14 seed gets no easy path. But Fils is the hottest player in men's tennis right now. Don't sleep on him.
